name: NumberFlow
summary: React component that animates and formats numbers as they change, with locale, prefix and suffix support.
description: An animated number component for React, distributed as the @number-flow/react package. It transitions digits automatically when the value changes and takes Intl.NumberFormat options, locales, prefix/suffix, custom timings, trend direction, digit configuration and a continuous plugin; it works with Motion layout animations and exposes a custom element with styling parts. Examples include input, activity and countdown templates.
contains: animated number component for React, Vue, Svelte and TS/JS
props: Intl.NumberFormat options, locales, prefix/suffix, timings, trend, digits, plugins
